boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented Winona-campus spaces for studying, collaborating, recreation, performance, and everyday student connection.

cards.title: Set up at the Reference Room
cards.subtitle: Fitzgerald Library, main level
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or a study partner and use the long tables, outlet access, chairs, or nearby computers on the library’s main level.
cards.short_summary: A main-level library workspace with tables, power, seating, and computers.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s identifies the Reference Room as a main-level Fitzgerald Library space with chairs, long tables near power outlets, and computers.
cards.source_title: Winona Study Spaces | Saint Mary's Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Fitzgerald Library on the Winona campus; check the library’s current hours before going.

cards.title: Meet in McEnery Lounge
cards.subtitle: Fitzgerald Library, first floor
cards.notes: Use this first-floor lounge when your group needs room to spread out, talk through an assignment, or work alongside other students.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor collaborative lounge in Fitzgerald Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s describes McEnery Lounge as a first-floor collaborative environment for individual and group study activities.
cards.source_title: Winona Study Spaces | Saint Mary's Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Fitzgerald Library; library access and room availability may vary.

cards.title: Reserve a group study room
cards.subtitle: Fitzgerald Library
cards.notes: Reserve one of the library’s group rooms when you need a defined place to rehearse, plan, or focus together on coursework.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms intended for group study.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s says Fitzgerald Library has numerous study rooms that students can reserve for group study.
cards.source_title: Winona Study Spaces | Saint Mary's Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; use the library’s study-room reservation information.

cards.title: Use McEnery Classroom 33 between classes
cards.subtitle: Fitzgerald Library, lower level
cards.notes: Check whether class is in session, then use Classroom 33 as an extra lower-level work setting for reading, drafting, or group prep.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level McEnery classroom available to students outside scheduled classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s says students may use McEnery Classroom 33 whenever classes are not in session.
cards.source_title: Winona Study Spaces | Saint Mary's Libraries
cards.access_notes: Available only when classes are not in session.

cards.title: Check Classroom 39 for open work time
cards.subtitle: Fitzgerald Library, lower level
cards.notes: Look for an unscheduled window and use Classroom 39 as a practical alternative workspace when the rest of the library feels busy.
cards.short_summary: A second lower-level McEnery classroom open outside class sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s says students may use McEnery Classroom 39 whenever classes are not in session.
cards.source_title: Winona Study Spaces | Saint Mary's Libraries
cards.access_notes: Available only when classes are not in session.

cards.title: Take a quieter seat upstairs
cards.subtitle: Fitzgerald Library, Upper McEnery
cards.notes: Choose a chair or table in Upper McEnery when you want a quieter library change of scene, with computers and a printer nearby.
cards.short_summary: An upper-level library area with seating, tables, computers, and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s lists the Upper McEnery Study Area with chairs, tables, two PCs, and a printer.
cards.source_title: Winona Study Spaces | Saint Mary's Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Fitzgerald Library; check current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Work in The Pit
cards.subtitle: Fitzgerald Library, Lower McEnery
cards.notes: Use The Pit when you need a Mac, scanner, printer, or a study table; it is a practical stop for production-focused course work.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level lab with Macs, scanning, printing, and study tables.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s says the Lower McEnery Lab, called “The Pit,” has four Mac computers, a printer, scanner, and study tables.
cards.source_title: Winona Study Spaces | Saint Mary's Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Fitzgerald Library; equipment availability may vary.

cards.title: Claim a study carrel
cards.subtitle: Fitzgerald Library, all floors
cards.notes: Pick a carrel when you need concentrated solo time, then use the library’s three-floor layout to find the level that suits your task.
cards.short_summary: Individual study carrels distributed throughout the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s states that Fitzgerald Library offers study carrels on all floors for concentrated study.
cards.source_title: Winona Study Spaces | Saint Mary's Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Fitzgerald Library; check current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Orient around Toner Student Center
cards.subtitle: Winona campus student center
cards.notes: Use the center as a campus waypoint for dining, the bookstore, games, lounge time, and student support offices; confirm each service’s availability.
cards.short_summary: A central student-services building with dining, lounge, games, bookstore, and support offices.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Winona campus map lists Michael H. Toner Student Center with dining areas, a lounge, game room, bookstore, and student-support services.
cards.source_title: Saint Mary’s University of Minnesota Winona Campus Map
cards.access_notes: On the Winona campus; individual dining, bookstore, game-room, and office access may vary.

cards.title: Find a performance at the Performance Center
cards.subtitle: Winona campus
cards.notes: Check the university calendar, then use the Performance Center’s named theatre, recital, studio, and lobby venues as a starting point for campus arts events.
cards.short_summary: The campus performance building includes theatre, recital, studio, and lobby venues.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Winona campus map lists the Performance Center with Joseph Page Theatre, Figliulo Recital Hall, Studio Theatre, and Ben Miller Lobby.
cards.source_title: Saint Mary’s University of Minnesota Winona Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Event access depends on the scheduled performance or campus activity.
